body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-10-31 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "we are on track to achieve targeted revenue growth of 25% plus at both standalone and consol level, compared to our earlier guidance of 20% to 25%" Metric: Revenue growth. Target: >=+25%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-21: partly. Evidence: FY26 consol +21.6% (0.86), standalone +22.9% (0.92). In May-26 management listed its FY26 target as '20% to 25%' and said it had 'fully delivered on each of these promises'; the raise to 25%+ was not mentioned. Explanation given: none; the raised target was not referred to
